section.content: 一种半导体集成电路，当从在高频下振荡的环形振荡电路中引出多相位时钟信号布线时，能够防止衬底面积的增加以及由于在多相位时钟信号布线中不均匀的寄生电容引起的时钟相位精度的降低。该半导体集成电路包括：环形连接的N级放大电路，以进行振荡操作，放大电路布置在分成多行的半导体衬底中，其中在每一行中，第“m-1”级放大电路不与第“m”级放大电路相邻，其中m是从2到N范围内的任意整数；以及多个布线，用于分别从放在多个行中的一行中的放大电路中引出多个输出信号。

A semiconductor integrated circuit in which, when leading out multiple-phase clock signal wirings from the ring oscillator circuit capable of oscillating at a high frequency, increase in the area of the substrate and deterioration in the clock phase accuracy caused by the non-uniform stray capacitances among the multiple-phase clock signal wirings are prevented. The semiconductor integrated circuit includes: N-stage amplifying circuits connected in a form of a ring to perform oscillating operation, which amplifying circuits are arranged in a semiconductor substrate to be divided into a plurality of rows, wherein in each row an amplifying circuit of 'm-1'th stage and an amplifying circuit of 'm'th stage are not adjacent to each other, where m is an arbitrary integer number within a range from 2 to N; and a plurality of wirings for respectively leading out a plurality of output signals from the amplifying circuits disposed in one of the plurality of rows.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, more particularly, relate to the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises the annular oscillation circuit that is used to produce multi-phase clock signal.

Background technology

At present, between equipment, transmit signal and adopt high-speed serial signals system by a small margin.Compare with the technology of parallel convey digital signal, this system can reduce the electromagnetic interference (EMI) that produces in the transmission course of digital signal, and only needs a spot of cable.

In order to realize high-speed serial communication, provide the parallel-to-serial change-over circuit at transmitter side, have the uniformly-spaced leggy period of the day from 11 p.m. to 1 a.m clock signal (in this application, being called multi-phase clock signal) of phase difference by use, synchronously parallel data is converted to serial data with reference clock signal.Therefore, occurred producing multi-phase clock signal and producing the needs of circuit for the parallel-to-serial change-over circuit provides the multi-phase clock signal of multi-phase clock signal.

Produce circuit as multi-phase clock signal, for example, the voltage that the multilevel delay difference see-saw circuit that use circularizes by being connected to each other constitutes or the difference annular oscillation circuit of Current Control.By using above-mentioned difference annular oscillation circuit, can from multilevel delay difference see-saw circuit, extract multi-phase clock signal at an easy rate with equally spaced phase difference.In order to produce multi-phase clock signal, the load of multilevel delay difference see-saw circuit is equated, and the parasitic capacitance of multi-phase clock signal wiring is equated with accurate equally spaced phase difference from the high-speed-differential annular oscillation circuit.

Usually, for the loads at different levels that make the delay difference see-saw circuit equate, place the N level delay difference see-saw circuit that constitutes the difference annular oscillation circuit in two row on Semiconductor substrate, in every row, adopt the arrangement placed adjacent one another of continuous delay difference see-saw circuit.The advantage of this arrangement is, can minimize the delay in the wiring between the input of the output of a circuit in the N level delay difference see-saw circuit and next circuit, and can be implemented in the difference annular oscillation circuit of the higher-order of oscillation.

But having uniformly-spaced in output, the multi-phase clock signal and the requirement of phase difference realize extracting multi-phase clock signal usually from the output that replaces the delay difference see-saw circuit in the difference annular oscillation circuit of high-speed serial communication.Therefore, each row of the delay difference see-saw circuit from be placed on two row extracts signal.Therefore, according to conventional scheme and wiring, the length of arrangement wire of the multi-phase clock signal in the delegation the equal difficulty of all parasitic capacitances of multi-phase clock signal wiring just occurred making greater than the length of arrangement wire of another row.And, the layout of be in the periphery of difference annular oscillation circuit carrying out the multi-phase clock signal wiring in the zone of broad.Owing to this reason, the area that Semiconductor substrate occurred becomes big problem.

Summary of the invention

Therefore, because the problems referred to above, an object of the present invention is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, wherein, when from the annular oscillation circuit that can under high frequency, vibrate, drawing or extracting the multi-phase clock signal wiring, can prevent the increase and because the reduction of the clock phase precision that uneven parasitic capacitance causes in the multi-phase clock signal wiring of Substrate Area.

In order to address the above problem, the semiconductor integrated circuit of first scheme comprises according to the present invention: the N level amplifying circuit (N is a natural number) that annular connects, to carry out oscillating operation, amplifying circuit is arranged in the Semiconductor substrate that is divided into multirow, wherein in each row, " m-1 " level amplifying circuit is not adjacent with " m " level amplifying circuit, and wherein m is the arbitrary integer in 2 to the N scopes; And a plurality of wirings, be used for drawing a plurality of output signals in the amplifying circuit from the delegation that is placed on a plurality of row respectively.

In addition, the semiconductor integrated circuit of alternative plan comprises according to the present invention: the N level amplifying circuit that annular connects, have equiphase M phase clock signal (M and N are natural number, and MN) at interval to carry out oscillating operation output, amplifying circuit is arranged in the Semiconductor substrate that is divided into two row; And M wiring, be used for from the amplifying circuit that is placed on two delegation of going, drawing M phase clock signal respectively.

According to the present invention, form a plurality of wirings, draw or extract a plurality of output signals (multi-phase clock signal) thereby from be placed on Semiconductor substrate, be divided in the delegation of N level amplifying circuit of multirow.Therefore, the parasitic capacitance in the multi-phase clock signal wiring is equated, and therefore prevent the increase of Substrate Area and the reduction of the precision in the clock phase signal wiring.

By also in conjunction with the accompanying drawings, advantages and features of the invention will be become apparent with reference to following detailed introduction.In these accompanying drawings, components identical adopts identical reference number.

Best mode of the present invention

Fig. 1 shows the circuit diagram of the voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit that comprises in the first embodiment of the invention semiconductor integrated circuit.

As shown in Figure 1, voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit comprises N level (being 8 grades in the present embodiment) delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h and the control end 102 that is controlled at the time of delay in the delay difference see-saw circuits at different levels.Control voltage source 103 is connected to control end 102.

Shown in Fig. 2 A, delay difference see-saw circuits 101 at different levels have non-inverting input 206 and inverting input 207 and noninverting output 208 and reversed-phase output 209.The control voltage VC that is added to control voltage input terminal 210 is controlled at the time of delay in the delay difference see-saw circuit 101.Perhaps, Control current can be controlled at the time of delay in the delay difference see-saw circuit 101.

Fig. 2 B shows the internal circuit diagram of delay difference see-saw circuits at different levels.Delay difference see-saw circuit 101 comprises the resistance 201 and 202 that is used to change voltage, MOS transistor 203 and 204 and constant-current source 205.Delay difference see-saw circuit 101 will be added in the signal of non-inverting input 206 and be added in the differential signal that the difference between the signal of inverting input 207 obtains and be added to noninverting output 208 and reversed-phase output 209 by amplification.Change at the drain electrode of each MOS transistor 203 and 204 and the voltage between the source electrode by the control voltage VC that is added to control voltage input terminal 210.Thereby, be controlled at the time of delay in the delay difference see-saw circuit 101.Though MOS transistor is as amplifier element in the present embodiment, the present invention also can be used for adopting in the situation of other element as amplifier element.

Again with reference to figure 1, voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100 comprises the delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h that 8 grades of annulars connect.Delay difference see-saw circuits at different levels have differential input end to 104 and difference output end to 105.The difference output end of first order delay difference see-saw circuit 101a is connected to the differential input end of second level delay difference see-saw circuit 101b to 104 to 105, the difference output end of second level delay difference see-saw circuit 101b to 105 differential input ends that are connected to third level delay difference see-saw circuit 101c to 104, or the like.Thus, the difference output end of last the 8th grade of delay difference see-saw circuit 101h is connected to the differential input end of first order delay difference see-saw circuit 101a to 104 to 105 in cross-coupled mode.As a result, connect into each difference output end of 8 grades of annular delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h as mentioned above to 105 generation clock signal Φ 1-Φ 16.

Fig. 3 shows the voltage waveform of clock signal Φ 1-Φ 16.In Fig. 3, the axis of abscissas express time, and axis of ordinates is represented voltage.The unit delay time T that delay difference see-saw circuits at different levels are anti-phase with respect to input signal and output delay is determined by added control voltage VC DELAYSignal.Here, in the difference annular oscillation circuit that constitutes by N level delay difference see-saw circuit, be the clock cycle T of frequency of oscillation inverse CLOCKBy following formulate:

T CLOCK＝2×N×T DELAY＝16×T DELAY (1)

Illustrated as formula (1), the clock cycle T of difference annular oscillation circuit CLOCKDepend on the progression N and the unit delay time T at different levels of delay difference see-saw circuit DELAYIn above-mentioned difference annular oscillation circuit, when add control voltage produces the minimum delay, in order to obtain high oscillation frequency, require the progression of designed delay difference see-saw circuit minimum, thereby and the parasitic capacitance that reduces in the output of delay difference see-saw circuit wiring reduce unit delay time T DELAY

Incidentally, in order to realize high-speed serial communication, need have the uniformly-spaced multi-phase clock signal of phase difference.According to the number of phases of determining multi-phase clock signal corresponding to the quantity of the serial data of a parallel data.The multi-phase clock signal that usually, need have 4-10 phase place.Now, introduce from clock signal Φ 1-Φ 16 shown in Figure 3, select to carry out high-speed serial communication required and have a uniformly-spaced method of the multi-phase clock signal of phase difference.

Usually, in order to produce the M phase clock signal, can use difference annular oscillation circuit (n is natural number) with N=n * M difference see-saw circuit.But, as mentioned above, the clock cycle T of difference annular oscillation circuit CLOCKMinimum value depend on the sum of series unit delay time T at different levels of delay difference see-saw circuit DELAYTherefore, in order to obtain the required high oscillation frequency of serial communication, preferably progression is required minimum value.Therefore, select the condition of n=1 usually.But the present invention also can be applicable to the situation of n＞1.In the present embodiment, adopt structure with 8 grades of delay difference see-saw circuits, n=1 wherein, that is, N=M, thus 8 phase clock signals produced.

In order to obtain having the uniformly-spaced multi-phase clock signal of 8 phase places of phase difference from the clock signal of these delay difference see-saw circuit outputs, selection phase difference each other is for equaling clock cycle T CLOCKClock signal divided by 8.With reference to figure 3, as this clock signal, odd number clock signal Φ 1, Φ 3, Φ 5 ... with Φ 15 or even number clock signal Φ 2, Φ 4, Φ 6 ... with Φ 16 are suitable clock signal.In the present embodiment, select the odd number clock signal.But, select the even number clock signal can obtain identical effect equally.

Fig. 4 shows voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit that comprises and the circuit diagram that cushions circuit in the semiconductor integrated circuit according to the first embodiment of the present invention.Here, for voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100 as shown in Figure 1, for as odd number clock signal Φ 1, the Φ 3 of multi-phase clock signal output, Φ 5 ... eight buffer circuit 301a-301h have been increased with Φ 15.

In order to reduce the parasitic capacitance in the output wiring of delay difference see-saw circuit, need layout and wiring, thereby when on Semiconductor substrate, forming circuit shown in Figure 4, can make that to extend to the output line 302a-302d of multi-phase clock signal of buffer circuit 301a-301h from delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h the shortest.

To achieve these goals, can contemplate place and route shown in Figure 5.As shown in Figure 5, delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h is placed in two row.In each row, except two ends, delay difference see-saw circuit placed adjacent.In addition, place buffer circuit 301a-301h near delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h, thereby output line 302a-302d is short as far as possible.By designing above-mentioned place and route, can access connection minimum wiring length at different levels, and therefore mean deviation minimizes owing to connect the parasitic capacitance that the wiring of adjacent level causes.But, according to above-mentioned wiring, be used for providing from buffering circuit 301a-301h to parallel-to-serial change-over circuit 402 clock signal Φ 1, Φ 3, Φ 5 ... arrange and draw at the upside and the downside of voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100 respectively with the wiring of Φ 15.As a result, between the parasitic capacitance of the wiring 401a of the multi-phase clock signal of upside and the parasitic capacitance at the wiring 401b of the multi-phase clock signal of downside great difference has appearred.

In high-speed serial communication, it is very important obtaining the accurately equal multi-phase clock signal of phase place.Therefore, when wiring multi-phase clock signal on Semiconductor substrate, the layout of the multi-phase clock signal of exactissima diligentia on Semiconductor substrate.That is, the electromagnetism/capacitive coupling of multi-phase clock signal is equated.In addition, as shown in Figure 5, when drawing the multi-phase clock signal wiring the zone of the broad around voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100, this zone can not be used as other purpose.Therefore, need large-area Semiconductor substrate.

Therefore, in the present embodiment, adopt place and route as shown in Figure 6.As shown in Figure 6, in Semiconductor substrate, place the buffer circuit 301a-301h and the parallel-to-serial change-over circuit 402 of voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100, multi-phase clock signal.The delay difference see-saw circuit 101a-101h that annular connects in voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100 alternately is placed in first row and second row, is different from the order of connection in circuit.By alternately placing them as mentioned above, can only draw or extract multi-phase clock signal from a side that is positioned at first row or the second delay difference see-saw circuit of going.In Fig. 6, delay difference see-saw circuit 101a, 101g, 101c and the 101e from be placed on down skidding draws multi-phase clock signal thereby only can connect up fully.Therefore, the lead-out wiring 401c of multi-phase clock signal can all concentrate on the downside of voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit 100.According to the advantage of this scheme, the parasitic capacitance of multi-phase clock signal wiring is equated.

Fig. 7 A is the key diagram of the layout of 8 grades of delay difference see-saw circuits shown in the key diagram 6; And Fig. 7 B is the key diagram of the layout of 8 grades of delay difference see-saw circuits shown in the Fig. 5 that illustrates as a comparative example.In Fig. 7 A and 7B, digital #1-#8 has provided the order of connection of delay difference see-saw circuit in the circuit.In the comparative example shown in Fig. 7 B, the order of connection in the circuit is identical with the order of its placement.In the embodiment shown in Fig. 7 A, the order of connection in the circuit is different with the order of its placement.

Can see that by Fig. 7 A and 7B the length of arrangement wire that connects 8 grades of delay difference see-saw circuits in the present embodiment is greater than the length of arrangement wire in the comparative example.But the length of arrangement wire at the two ends of the row of length of arrangement wire in the present embodiment and the delay difference see-saw circuit in comparative example is roughly the same.Therefore, be not less than the high frequency characteristics of the voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit in comparative example according to the high frequency characteristics of the voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit of present embodiment.

Below, introduce the second embodiment of the present invention.Fig. 8 is the figure of the layout of the delay difference see-saw circuit that comprises in the voltage control difference annular oscillation circuit of explanation in semiconductor integrated circuit according to a second embodiment of the present invention.In the present embodiment, the progression N of delay difference see-saw circuit is made as 10.In Fig. 8, digital #1-#10 has provided the order of connection of delay difference see-saw circuit in the circuit.

As shown in Figure 8, even when in first and second row, alternately placing these delay difference see-saw circuits, the progression of the delay difference see-saw circuit that annular connects, only the delay difference see-saw circuit from be placed on first or second row is extracted multi-phase clock signal.Therefore, the parasitic capacitance of multi-phase clock signal wiring is equal to each other.

Usually, under the situation of using N level delay difference see-saw circuit, suppose m=1,2, N, at m is to be equal to or less than under the situation of odd number of N/2, m level amplifying circuit is placed on m position of the row of first in the Semiconductor substrate, under m is situation greater than the odd number of N/2, m level amplifying circuit is placed on N+1-m position of the row of first in the Semiconductor substrate, at m is to be equal to or less than under the situation of even number of N/2, m level amplifying circuit is placed on m position of the row of second in the Semiconductor substrate, under m was situation greater than the even number of N/2, m level amplifying circuit was placed on N+1-m position of the row of second in the Semiconductor substrate.

Though introduced the present invention based on embodiment, the present invention is not limited to the foregoing description, and can make amendment in the scope described in claims or change.

Industrial usability

Between can be used for using annular oscillation circuit to produce to have etc. according to semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention In the image device of the multi-phase clock signal of phase difference, computer etc.
